smt-2018-general-tiebreaker-01.title: System of equations
smt-2018-general-tiebreaker-01.body:
Let $x$ mangos and $y$ pineapples initially. After the harvest: $\frac32x$ mangos and $\frac12y$ pineapples. Equal counts give $3x=y$. The net loss of $10$: $x+y-10=\frac32x+\frac12y$, so $y-x=20$. Then $2x=20$, $x=10$, $y=30$, and she started with $40$ fruit.

**Answer: 40**

smt-2018-general-tiebreaker-02.title: Equilateral triangle of centers
smt-2018-general-tiebreaker-02.body:
The centers $A,B,C$ form an equilateral triangle of side $6$. The center $O$ of the large circle is the centroid, so $OA$ is the circumradius $\frac{6}{\sqrt3}=2\sqrt3$. The large circle has radius $OA+3=3+2\sqrt3$.

**Answer: $3+2\sqrt3$**
